new_value: Fixed: _adopt_locked now gates the network-replay-barrier insert behind the time-authorization predicates (python/src/lichen/timing/stratum.py:630-633). An unauthorized-transport or unauthorized-peer NETWORK sample is rejected with the identical reason strings _rejection produces ('network-transport-not-authorized' / 'network-peer-not-authorized-for-time') WITHOUT inserting into or reordering __network_high_water - so attacker-controlled signer keys admitted to the verifier's peer_origins can no longer flood the 256-slot LRU and evict a victim signer's high-water to reopen the replay window. The eviction-exposure was possible precisely because the barrier insert used to run before _rejection's authorization checks; unauthorized peers can never adopt, so consuming barrier slots for them was pure attack surface. NOT changed: the authorized-path one-use semantics from fxrh (option-mismatch still consumes the barrier; pinning test test_option_mismatch_rejection_consumes_network_replay_high_water unchanged and green). Pinned by new test test_unauthorized_transport_dio_does_not_consume_replay_barrier: unauthorized-transport consideration -> transport-not-authorized twice (same counter, barrier NOT consumed - old code returned replay-counter-not-new), then after an operator policy flip (replace_policy adding NETWORK+peer) the SAME sealed DIO (same counter) is ADOPTED instead of being poisoned as a replay of a consideration that could never have succeeded; adoption then enforces one-use as usual. Verification on heft: python/tests/timing 877/877 (incl. the 74 in test_time_sync.py); ruff clean on both touched files. 3x delegated codereview: correctness PASS (reason-string identity with _rejection; no skipped adoption path; test discriminates old vs new; _clear_locked/replace_policy barrier retention verified), security PASS (unauthorized path grows nothing - memory-exhaustion via unauthorized flooding closed; policy is operator-held immutable config; only self-information leaked to the rejected peer), edge PASS (issuance_high_water bounded by the fixed authorities tuple; re-authorization replay flow correct).
